en-US.title: Deckhead
en-US.subtitle: Charades Party Game
en-US.promoText: Phone on your forehead. Your friends yell clues. Banned-words mode, three-round mode, chaos twists and 14 free decks. No ads, no account.
en-US.description:
Hold the phone to your forehead. A word pops up that everyone can see except you. Your friends yell clues, act it out, hum it — anything but say the word — and you get as many as you can before time's up.

ONE TAP TO PLAY
Swipe through decks like lenses and hit the button. You're playing. Want teams and house rules? They're one tap away.

14 FREE DECKS
College Life, Gen Z Slang, Viral Internet, Reality TV, Music Icons, Anime & Gaming, 2010s Throwback, Snacks & Fast Food, Emoji Charades and more. No ads. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. No account.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
Classic. Banned Words, where the room can't say the words under the card. And 3 Rounds: the same cards come back three times — describe it, then one word, then act it out. It gets funnier every round.

CHAOS AND FORFEITS
Turn on chaos for a wild rule some rounds: accents only, hum it, double points, speed round. Turn on forfeits and last place gets a dare.

MAKE YOUR OWN
Answer five questions about your friend group and get a deck only you can play. Add photos of faces to cards. Paste a whole list. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, type a theme and the cards write themselves — on your phone, offline.

SHARE IN SECONDS
Show a code and the whole room has your deck. AirDrop it and it opens straight in Deckhead. Big decks travel as a quick flip of codes. Nothing gets uploaded anywhere.

YOUR NIGHT, WRAPPED
The MVP, the fastest guess, the card nobody could get — one image to post. Film the room for a highlight reel, keep a friends leaderboard, and keep your streak alive.

CONTROLS THAT WORK
Tap the top of the screen if you got it, the bottom to pass. Giant targets you can hit without looking. Prefer tilting? Turn it on. Or switch on the voice referee and it hears the answer for you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Deckhead works fully offline and collects nothing. Your decks, photos, videos, games and streak stay on your phone. Speech and AI features run on your iPhone itself.
en-US.releaseNotes: Game night update: nine new decks, Banned Words and 3 Rounds modes, chaos twists and forfeits, a friends leaderboard, Tonight Wrapped, photo cards, a deck-about-your-group builder, a voice referee, round videos with a highlight reel, and AI decks written on your iPhone.
